unit.id: The First Computer#1

segment.source: The First Computer
segment.target: Komputer Pertama

unit.id: Code named "Project PX" and funded by the United States Army, the first general-purpose computer was the Electronic Numerical Integrator And Computer (ENIAC). It was developed at the University of Pennsylvania's Moore School of Electrical Engineering.#1

segment.source: Code named "Project PX" and funded by the United States Army, the first general-purpose computer was the Electronic Numerical Integrator And Computer (ENIAC). It was developed at the University of Pennsylvania's Moore School of Electrical Engineering.
segment.target: Dengan nama sandi “Project PX” dan pendanaan dari Angkatan Darat Amerika Serikat, komputer serbaguna pertama itu bernama Electronic Numerical Integrator And Computer (ENIAC). Komputer ini dikembangkan di Sekolah Teknik Elektro Moore, Universitas Pennsylvania.

unit.id: ... And The Women Who Made It Work#1

segment.source: ... And The Women Who Made It Work
segment.target: … dan Para Perempuan yang Membuatnya Berfungsi

unit.id: The ENIAC programmers included a number of women: Jean Bartik, Marlyn Wescoff Meltzer, Ruth Lichterman Teitelbaum, Kay McNulty Mauchly Antonelli, Frances Spence, and Frances Elizabeth "Betty" Holberton. Despite their groundbreaking work, the Army never released the names of the women who worked on the ENIAC, and they were largely forgotten until Kathy Kleiman discovered their story in 1985.#1

segment.source: The ENIAC programmers included a number of women: Jean Bartik, Marlyn Wescoff Meltzer, Ruth Lichterman Teitelbaum, Kay McNulty Mauchly Antonelli, Frances Spence, and Frances Elizabeth "Betty" Holberton. Despite their groundbreaking work, the Army never released the names of the women who worked on the ENIAC, and they were largely forgotten until Kathy Kleiman discovered their story in 1985.
segment.target: Sejumlah pemrogram ENIAC adalah perempuan: Jean Bartik, Marlyn Wescoff Meltzer, Ruth Lichterman Teitelbaum, Kay McNulty Mauchly Antonelli, Frances Spence, dan Frances Elizabeth “Betty” Holberton. Terlepas dari karya rintisan mereka, Angkatan Darat tidak pernah mengungkap nama para perempuan yang mengerjakan ENIAC. Mereka pun hampir terlupakan hingga Kathy Kleiman menemukan kisah mereka pada 1985.

unit.id: Rózsa Péter: The Poet of Recursion#1

segment.source: Rózsa Péter: The Poet of Recursion
segment.target: Rózsa Péter, Penyair Rekursi

unit.id: Hungarian-born Rózsa Péter studied number theory and poetry before becoming interested in the idea that would become recursion theory. She published her paper "Recursive Functions" in 1951, but it wasn't until the mid-50's that she began to apply her work to the realm of computers.#1

segment.source: Hungarian-born Rózsa Péter studied number theory and poetry before becoming interested in the idea that would become recursion theory. She published her paper "Recursive Functions" in 1951, but it wasn't until the mid-50's that she began to apply her work to the realm of computers.
segment.target: Rózsa Péter, yang lahir di Hungaria, mempelajari teori bilangan dan puisi sebelum tertarik pada gagasan yang kemudian menjadi teori rekursi. Ia menerbitkan makalah “Recursive Functions” pada 1951, tetapi baru mulai menerapkan karyanya pada komputer pada pertengahan 1950-an.

unit.id: Grace Hopper Invents The Compiler#1

segment.source: Grace Hopper Invents The Compiler
segment.target: Grace Hopper Menciptakan Kompilator

unit.id: In her career with the Navy, Rear Admiral Grace Hopper worked on the first commercial computer (UNIVAC) and laid the groundwork for the programming language COBOL. But her most notable invention was the compiler, which can transform a source language into binary code. (In other words, it can translate the code you and I write into 0s and 1s.) She developed it in 1952, but she said "Nobody would touch it. They told me computers could only do arithmetic."#1

segment.source: In her career with the Navy, Rear Admiral Grace Hopper worked on the first commercial computer (UNIVAC) and laid the groundwork for the programming language COBOL. But her most notable invention was the compiler, which can transform a source language into binary code. (In other words, it can translate the code you and I write into 0s and 1s.) She developed it in 1952, but she said "Nobody would touch it. They told me computers could only do arithmetic."
segment.target: Semasa bertugas di Angkatan Laut, Laksamana Muda Grace Hopper mengerjakan komputer komersial pertama, UNIVAC, dan meletakkan dasar bahasa pemrograman COBOL. Namun, penemuannya yang paling penting ialah kompilator yang mengubah bahasa sumber menjadi kode biner. Dengan kata lain, kompilator menerjemahkan kode yang kita tulis menjadi angka 0 dan 1. Ia mengembangkannya pada 1952, tetapi berkata, “Tidak ada yang mau menggunakannya. Mereka bilang komputer hanya bisa berhitung.”

unit.id: Contributions To Space Exploration#1

segment.source: Contributions To Space Exploration
segment.target: Kontribusi bagi Penjelajahan Antariksa

unit.id: One of the first African-American women to earn a Ph.D in mathematics, Evelyn Boyd Granville focused on aeronautics and space during her career. In 1956, she worked with NASA and IBM on Project Mercury, the first manned space flight. She worked with NASA again a few years later on the Apollo Project.#1

segment.source: One of the first African-American women to earn a Ph.D in mathematics, Evelyn Boyd Granville focused on aeronautics and space during her career. In 1956, she worked with NASA and IBM on Project Mercury, the first manned space flight. She worked with NASA again a few years later on the Apollo Project.
segment.target: Evelyn Boyd Granville, salah satu perempuan Afrika-Amerika pertama yang meraih gelar doktor matematika, menekuni aeronautika dan antariksa dalam kariernya. Pada 1956, ia bekerja sama dengan NASA dan IBM dalam Proyek Mercury, penerbangan antariksa berawak pertama. Beberapa tahun kemudian ia kembali bekerja dengan NASA dalam Proyek Apollo.

segment.source: The First PHD in Computer Science
segment.target: Gelar Doktor Ilmu Komputer Pertama

unit.id: One of the first women (if not the first woman) to earn a Ph.D in computer science, Sister Mary Kenneth Keller also contributed to the development of the BASIC language during her time at Dartmouth College. She then founded the computer science department at Clarke College and directed it for the next 20 years.#1

segment.source: One of the first women (if not the first woman) to earn a Ph.D in computer science, Sister Mary Kenneth Keller also contributed to the development of the BASIC language during her time at Dartmouth College. She then founded the computer science department at Clarke College and directed it for the next 20 years.
segment.target: Suster Mary Kenneth Keller adalah salah satu perempuan pertama yang meraih gelar doktor ilmu komputer, dan mungkin yang pertama. Saat di Dartmouth College, ia juga ikut mengembangkan bahasa BASIC. Ia kemudian mendirikan departemen ilmu komputer di Clarke College dan memimpinnya selama 20 tahun.

unit.id: Ancient Olympic Games#1

segment.source: Ancient Olympic Games
segment.target: Olimpiade Kuno

unit.id: The first written evidence of the official Games dates from 776 BC, when the Greeks began measuring time in Olympiads, or the duration between each edition of the Olympic Games. The first Olympic Games were held every four years in honour of the god Zeus. From then on, a number of artistic activities such as music, singing, poetry and theatre were organised at the Pythian or Delphic Games (a separate event to the Games held in Olympia), linking culture and sport right from the beginning of the Games.#1

segment.source: The first written evidence of the official Games dates from 776 BC, when the Greeks began measuring time in Olympiads, or the duration between each edition of the Olympic Games. The first Olympic Games were held every four years in honour of the god Zeus. From then on, a number of artistic activities such as music, singing, poetry and theatre were organised at the Pythian or Delphic Games (a separate event to the Games held in Olympia), linking culture and sport right from the beginning of the Games.
segment.target: Bukti tertulis pertama tentang penyelenggaraan resmi berasal dari 776 SM, ketika orang Yunani mulai mengukur waktu dengan olimpiade, yaitu selang antara dua penyelenggaraan. Olimpiade pertama diadakan setiap empat tahun untuk menghormati Dewa Zeus. Sejak itu, kegiatan seni seperti musik, nyanyian, puisi, dan teater digelar dalam Pesta Olahraga Pitia atau Delfi, yang terpisah dari pesta di Olimpia. Budaya dan olahraga sudah berkaitan sejak awal.

unit.id: A number of initiatives to re-establish an international sporting event were attempted at the end of the 19th century, but failed due to the lack of coordination among the worldwide sporting movement - until one man decided to bring the main stakeholders together in Paris.#1

segment.source: A number of initiatives to re-establish an international sporting event were attempted at the end of the 19th century, but failed due to the lack of coordination among the worldwide sporting movement - until one man decided to bring the main stakeholders together in Paris.
segment.target: Beberapa upaya mengadakan kembali pesta olahraga internasional dilakukan pada akhir abad ke-19. Semuanya gagal karena gerakan olahraga dunia kurang terkoordinasi, hingga seseorang memutuskan mempertemukan pihak-pihak utama di Paris.

unit.id: The Olympic Games were therefore revived at the first Olympic Congress, organised by Baron Pierre de Coubertin and held at the Grand Amphitheatre at the Sorbonne University from 16 to 23 June 1894. Two thousand people attended, including 58 French delegates representing 24 sports organisations and clubs, and 20 delegates from Belgium, Great Britain, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Russia, Spain, Sweden and the United States representing 13 foreign sports federations.#1

segment.target: Olimpiade Pertama yang Terbuka bagi Atlet Penyandang Disabilitas

unit.id: The 1904 Olympic Games in St. Louis (Missouri) were the first to distribute gold, silver and bronze medals, and also included the first known disabled athlete to compete in the Olympic Games, George Eyser. He won six medals in gymnastics, three of which were gold.#1
